ActivationTarget.description: The explicit local Engine whose Compose daemon runs the Harness to activate. Never defaulted: it must not be the operator's own Harness by accident. The caller connects the [`IIIClient`] it hands to [`Promotion::new`] to `engine_url`.

compose_file.description: The compose file on the daemon host.

BaselineV1.description: The baseline measured against the frozen plan.

usable.description: Every criterion has its runs and a value: a candidate can be compared.

CanaryV1.description: The canary of the activated artifact against the frozen plan.

CandidateConfigV1.description: Operator configuration. Model and provider come from here, never from code.

base_sha.description: Exact 40-hex commit the candidate is based on.

publish_remote.description: Already configured remote the candidate branch may be pushed to; `None` disables [`publish`].

repository.description: Absolute path of the Workers repository.

worktrees_dir.description: Absolute directory for candidate worktrees; inside the repository only when git ignores it.

cost_usd.description: Measured by `harness::metrics`; `None` is unknown, never zero.

source.description: Where it was observed (execution, session, run, entry).

CandidateStateV1.description: The candidate's identity (persisted before it starts), latest state, tree and the branch it was published to.

oneOf.description: No Harness turn exists for the session: call [`start`] again.

CoverageV1.description: The objective mapped onto the E2E catalog, before any spend.

controls.description: The configured controls, each in its current definition.

gaps.description: The exact missing coverage when `covered` is false; limitations else.

need.description: The need the objective maps to (`context_consumption`, `provider_fallback`, `skills`), or `unmapped`.

CriterionMetricV1.description: What a criterion measures, per measurable run, averaged.

oneOf.description: Occurrences of `pattern` per run, by the detectors.
Share of runs that completed and passed (`task_incomplete` fails).
`awarded / possible` of the E2E criterion `criterion_id`; a run that did not evaluate it measures nothing.

min_effect.description: In the metric's unit (pp for pass rate and criterion score, s for duration); 0 makes any loss a regression.

CycleAnalysisV1.description: The deterministic first pass over one imported execution.

child_transcripts_complete.description: True only when the report says every child transcript was kept.

sentinel.description: What `sentinel::reports::ingest` answered for the runs' recorded failures; absent when the reports recorded none.

unknowns.description: What the stored copy could not tell; never assumed.

CycleBudgetV1.description: The limits of one cycle, covering every kind of its work.

max_duration_ms.description: Wall time since the cycle was created.

CycleExecutionV1.description: One E2E execution the cycle owns. Recorded before dispatch; `label` is deterministic (`eval:<cycle_id>:<role>[:n]`), the only correlation the E2E keeps.

route.description: Set when the execution runs on another Engine than this worker's: the canary on the explicit activation target. Recorded before the dispatch; every read goes through that Engine.

work_id.description: The budget reservation it was dispatched under.

CycleNextV1.description: The durable next step of a waiting cycle.

findings.description: Fingerprints of the findings it rests on.

CyclePlanV1.description: What a cycle commits to before any result.

criterion.description: The metric, its direction, the minimum effect and the scenario.

estimated_usd.description: What the baseline is reserved at: runs × scenarios × the configured per-run estimate.

policy_revision.description: The configuration revision the cycle runs under.

preserved.description: Correctness the candidate must keep: a loss rejects, an unmeasured one is inconclusive.

tests.description: The selected tests and controls, each with the executable identity of its current definition, frozen with the plan.

CycleRecordV1.description: The one record of a cycle, whichever input started it.

activation_intent.description: The Compose operation id of the activation, persisted before the pin is sent: a crash or a lost write between the two still counts as an activation in flight, never as nothing activated.

artifact_decision.description: The decision on the immutable rc artifact under the same frozen plan as `decision` (the source decision). Recorded once.

config.description: The configuration frozen when the cycle was created: later edits of the global configuration never change its actor, budget, target or criteria. `null`: created unconfigured.

plan.description: Frozen before any dispatch; never changes.

promotion.description: Every promotion phase, requested and confirmed apart.

recovery.description: Why an already requested activation is being restored instead of abandoned (a cancel or a budget limit). While set the cycle only reconciles the activation and proves the prior executable running; it is not terminal until that is proved.

step.description: Durable step counter; a queued step that does not match is stale.

CycleStageV1.description: Where the cycle is. An objective goes coverage, baseline, analysis, proposal, candidate, validation, analysis, promotion; an execution starts at analysis and, with a pertinent finding, goes coverage, triage (paid only when covered and ambiguous), then baseline.

oneOf.description: Ambiguous findings judged once (`judge::evaluate`), or the recorded reason no judgment is needed.
The bounded read-only proposal turning evidence into a brief.
The isolated candidate actor.
The candidate's source validation execution.
Merge, official release, final artifact comparison, activation and canary, journaled phase by phase.
Durably paused on an external event: an E2E execution to finish, or the candidate stage (`next`).

CycleUsageV1.description: What a cycle has drawn on its budget.

spend_usd.description: Reported costs plus the estimate of work without one.

unknown_cost.description: Work settled without a reported cost.

EvidenceIdentityV1.description: Identity of an imported execution as its reports state it. `None` is unknown (absent, or reports that disagree), never assumed.

fixed_stack_digest.description: Digest of every stack component but the Harness, as the reports prove it; unknown when they cannot.

harness_binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `/proc/<pid>/exe` of the ready Harness, captured by the E2E runner (`system_under_test.harness_binary_sha256`), never from the subject. Known only when every report agrees. Like the Harness version it is the product side, kept per side and never part of the fixed comparability; a final artifact decision and activation bind it.

subject_sha256.description: Digest of the full native subject configuration (model, provider, agent profile) as the reports state it.

EvidenceRunV1.description: One run as the E2E reported it; unreported values stay absent.

EvidenceV1.description: A criterion judged on a pair, in code.

ExecutionParametersV1.description: The E2E `ExecutionParameters` the plan dispatches, frozen with it.

ExecutionRoleV1.description: Why an execution belongs to the cycle.

oneOf.description: The execution that started the cycle.
The candidate's source validation.
The immutable rc artifact's final comparison.
The canary of the activated stable artifact.
Ownership recorded, `execution-start` called or about to be: its id may be unknown; it is reconciled by `label`, never dispatched again.
Terminal and its reports copied into the loop's evidence.
The dispatch was refused, or never appeared in the E2E.

FindingClassV1.description: The six classes the first pass sorts a finding into.

signal.description: The detector rule or execution signal it comes from.

estimated_usd.description: What one grouped question is reserved at.

provider.description: The judge provider (`judge::evaluate` hub routing), e.g. `typesafe`.

LoopConfigV1.description: Everything a cycle needs to spend on the E2E. Nothing has a default: an unconfigured loop selects coverage but dispatches nothing.

candidate.description: The bounded read-only proposal and the isolated candidate actor; absent: a cycle stops before any proposal, inconclusive.

controls.description: Control scenarios every plan also runs and preserves (pass rate and every spec criterion), e.g. `minimal_path`.

estimated_usd_per_run.description: What one run is reserved at before dispatch; an unreported actual cost stays charged at it, never at zero.

judge.description: Semantic triage of ambiguous findings through `judge::evaluate`; absent: an ambiguous finding stays inconclusive.

max_scenarios.description: Scenarios one plan may run at most.

promotion.description: Official release and explicit local activation; absent: an accepted source candidate is never merged, published or activated.

release_build_estimate_usd.description: What one official build (rc or finalization) is reserved at; its cost is not reported, so it stays charged at this. Required with `promotion`.

stack.description: Required for `docker` and `github`; refused for `harness`, which runs on its own stack.

validation.description: The stacks that pin the Harness under test; required to validate a candidate. With it, the baseline runs the candidate's base commit.

MinEffectV1.description: The minimum effect a plan freezes for each metric it can target.

oneOf.description: Evidence-backed candidate work, coordinated by a later stage.
The objective has no E2E coverage; `coverage.gaps` names it.
The analysis found nothing worth candidate work.
A limit of the cycle was reached.
The evidence cannot support a conclusion (e.g. an unusable baseline).
`decision` holds accepted, rejected or inconclusive; nothing was released.
Activated on the explicit target, the executable proved and the canary held.
The canary was violated and the prior executable is proved running again.

PromotionConfig.description: What a cycle may choose about a promotion: which archive target to digest and which local Engine to activate. Nothing here names a service or a credential.

artifact_target.description: The Registry `binaries` key whose archive is digested, e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`.

PromotionJournal.description: Everything one promotion did, in order. Persisted by the caller after each phase, before the next effect.

oneOf.description: The frozen source comparison decision: it authorizes merging exactly this candidate onto exactly this base, and nothing past the merge.

created.description: Opened by this call rather than found.

updated.description: False when `main` already was the candidate and nothing was sent. Either way the outcome is proved only by [`Promotion::read_merge`].

oneOf.description: `main` fast-forwarded to the candidate: the merged commit is the candidate commit, one parent on the approved base, with the approved tree. `main_sha` is `main` when it was read back (the candidate, or a later commit that contains it).
A Release Control preview frozen as it was answered.

preview_sha256.description: sha256 of the preview document as received.

target_version.description: The version the operation will publish: the rc for a deploy, the stable version for a finalization.

oneOf.description: An exact Registry version whose archive bytes were downloaded and hashed, matching the digest the Registry claims.

binary_sha256.description: sha256 of the archive's one regular `harness` entry: the executable this release installs. A separate fact from `archive_sha256`.

oneOf.description: The frozen decision on the immutable rc build, from an E2E run against it. `binary_sha256` is the running executable the run measured (`system_under_test.harness_binary_sha256`); absent is unknown.
A Release Control preview frozen as it was answered.

preview_sha256.description: sha256 of the preview document as received.

target_version.description: The version the operation will publish: the rc for a deploy, the stable version for a finalization.

oneOf.description: An exact Registry version whose archive bytes were downloaded and hashed, matching the digest the Registry claims.

binary_sha256.description: sha256 of the archive's one regular `harness` entry: the executable this release installs. A separate fact from `archive_sha256`.

oneOf.description: An immutable version whose archive and running executable were both validated. The two digests are separate facts and never compared.
A Compose pin this module asked for. `accepted: false` means the target already ran the destination and nothing was sent.
The target proved to run the expected executable.

pid.description: The Harness process whose executable was hashed.

supervisor_pid.description: The Compose-supervised process the Harness was found under.

oneOf.description: A Compose pin this module asked for. `accepted: false` means the target already ran the destination and nothing was sent.
The target proved to run the expected executable.

pid.description: The Harness process whose executable was hashed.

supervisor_pid.description: The Compose-supervised process the Harness was found under.

ProposalCitationV1.description: A source range in the base commit, repository-relative.

ProposalInputV1.description: What core knows about the case; copied verbatim into the brief.

evidence.description: Native evidence; untrusted data for the actor.

ProposalStateV1.description: The proposal's identity (persisted before it starts) and latest state.

ProposalV1.description: `status` is `completed` for a validated proposal and `failed` with code `insufficient_evidence` when the actor found no supported mechanism.

ReleasePlan.description: A Release Control preview frozen as it was answered.

preview_sha256.description: sha256 of the preview document as received.

target_version.description: The version the operation will publish: the rc for a deploy, the stable version for a finalization.

SamplingPlanV1.description: How many measured runs each side needs and the cases they run on.

seeds.description: The canonical `case_id`s both sides must report.

ScenarioIdentityV1.description: The executable identity of one reported scenario.

SelectedTestV1.description: A test selected as coverage hypothesis, with the executable identity of its CURRENT definition from `e2e::scenarios-list`.

history_note.description: Set when the catalog row's history is of another version.

invariants.description: The deliverable invariants the catalog declares.

matched_terms.description: Spec words that matched each required term group.

SentinelForwardV1.description: The runs' recorded failures forwarded to the central Sentinel. Its classification and triage are kept as it answered and reused, never judged again.

results.description: `results[]` as Sentinel answered: dedupe_key, classification, outcome, group_id, occurrence_id, group_status, triage.

StackV1.description: A stack in the E2E's own shape (`ExecutionStack`), e.g. `package://harness` pinned to `commit:<40 hex>` of `iii-hq/workers` path `harness`.

StopKind.description: Why a step did not produce its evidence.

oneOf.description: Missing or expired credentials, an unreachable service, or a target this module cannot observe.
The outcome cannot be proved: a lost response, mergeability not yet computed, an unknown executable digest.
A concrete divergence or failed precondition. The promotion stops.

StoredConfigV1.description: The stored configuration. `revision` (SHA-256 of the config and the rules) is the `policy_revision` every plan freezes.

SubjectV1.description: The model the E2E subject runs on. Credentials stay in the providers.

agent.description: Agent profile the subject runs under; absent uses the E2E default.

TestCriterionV1.description: One criterion of a test spec (`spec.criteria[]`), the id run reports award points under.

oneOf.description: No reasoning at all; honoured only where the model advertises `supports_thinking_off` (elsewhere the provider falls back to its own lowest setting, or omits the parameter, and warns).
The semantic step is unknown (unavailable, invalid or lost answer).
An explicit objective: no authorization needed.
A clear deterministic defect.
Sentinel's triage of the same occurrences, reused.

TriageV1.description: Why the cycle proceeds past its findings, or stops.

request_id.description: Set before `judge::evaluate` is called: a restart finds it and never asks twice.

reused.description: Sentinel triage of the same occurrences, as Sentinel answered.

ValidationConfigV1.description: E2E stacks in the E2E's own shape that pin only the Harness: everything else (Engine, evaluator, other workers) stays fixed between the sides.

artifact_stack_template.description: Stack YAML pinning an immutable Registry version; `{version}` is replaced by it.

source_stack_template.description: Stack YAML pinning a source revision; `{commit}` is replaced by the 40-hex sha.

WhereV1.description: Where the E2E runs a dispatched execution (`ExecutionParameters.where`).

oneOf.description: The E2E's own Harness: observes the current stack, cannot pin a candidate commit.
